mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:707-708 loads the helpers as a run, `AccessModel(MODEL_HELPER + i, L"Data\\Player\\", L"Helper", i + 1)`, so MODEL_HELPER+0 is Data/Player/Helper01.bmd; its textures come from Data/Item (:1343-1352). ITEM_GUARDIAN_ANGEL is ITEM_HELPER+0 (_enum.h:2701), group 13 number 0. The .bmd's own name for itself is Data2\Item\Helper\fairy.smd.
profile_note: A small creature on its own rig, seen close beside the character: the monster profile's situation, and its 3x cap. One model is the follower, the drop and the bag icon alike - MU has no separate item model for it.
rig_from: Eight bones and one action of seven keys. MU never calls SetAction on it (GOBoid.cpp MoveMount), so action 0 is all it ever plays, and at o->Velocity = 0.5 (GOBoid.cpp:67-126) where a townsperson's default is 0.25.
sheet_from: Data/Item/fairy.OZJ (16x16, the body, 46 triangles) and fairy2.OZJ (32x32, the wings, 4 triangles), from MuMain's own bin/Data. Neither has alpha.
additive_from: GOBoid.cpp CreateMount sets o->BlendMesh = 1 for MODEL_HELPER, and ItemObjectAttribute (ZzzObject.cpp:5321-5323) does the same for the drop: mesh 1, the wings, is added over what is behind it. Grey feathers on black, and the black is the part that adds nothing.
tiled_why: The wings are added and the baked path cannot say so: one atlas, one material, nowhere for a sheet to be added. Tiled keeps each sheet its own material, and tiled_maps turns the additive one emissive. Elf Lala's wing, ElfWizard01, is the same case.
sheet_materials_from: The body sheet is a painted face and gown in flesh tones; the wings are feathers. Judged from the sheets.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser.
stats.power_note: Damage taken x0.8 and +50 maximum health, applied only while its Life is above 0 (ItemPowerUpFactory.cs:38-41). The multiplier is taken in AttackableExtensions.cs:220-224, after the defence and the level/10 minimum and before the skill's multiplier. No options, no luck, no plus.
